normalization_plan.reason: The _user parameter only feeds depositToVault/withdrawFromVault bookkeeping and is folded into the function node.
The _token parameter is resolved through tokenInfo inside depositToVault and is folded into the function node.
The _amount parameter only feeds SafeMath accounting inside depositToVault and is folded into the function node.
The _strategy parameter is used by registerStrategy to push into strategies and set the vault, so it merges into that function.
The _tokens array only drives the withdrawFromVault loop and is folded into the function node.
The _amounts array is consumed by the batch withdrawFromVault loop and merges into that function node.
The account parameter is only used by claimDistributions to index distributions and merges into that function.
The sender parameter is a direct argument of the internal ERC20._transfer routine and merges into it.
The recipient parameter is a direct argument of the internal ERC20._transfer routine and merges into it.
The accounts array is iterated by claimDistributions to update balances and merges into that function.
The _index parameter is only bounds-checked and used by setRemainder and merges into that function.
The addedValue parameter is consumed by SafeMath.add in increaseAllowance and merges into it.
totalDeposit is a local accumulator computed inside operatorAction and merges into that function.
totalWithdraw is a local accumulator computed inside operatorAction and merges into that function.
amountToWithdraw is produced by requestToClaim and merges into that function.
withdrawAmounts is the local per-token array built inside operatorAction and merges into that function.
depositAmounts is the local per-token array built inside operatorAction and merges into that function.
initialBalance is the starting balance argument of _calculateDistributedAmount and merges into that function.
tokenBalance is the local liquidity value computed inside requestToClaim and merges into that function.
ind is the local token index returned by tokenRegisteredInd and merges into that function.
